summary: A Windows desktop overlay that captures system (loopback) audio, transcribes and translates it in real time, and displays the translation as subtitles over any application. Starts with Japanese-to-English for anime on streaming services like Prime, and is architected so any-language-to-any-language is a later extension.
goals: Low-latency captions that are readable in real time
Unobtrusive full-screen, transparent, click-through, always-on-top overlay that shows only subtitles
Japanese-to-English now, architected so any-language-to-any-language is a later extension
Runs on Windows, uses the GPU, and is built only from free/open-source tooling

features.name: Windows executable launch
features.description: The app is started from a packaged Windows .exe (no terminal or dev tooling required to run it).

features.name: Audio source selection
features.description: On launch the user picks which audio device to listen from, then the app starts capturing.

features.name: WASAPI loopback capture
features.description: Captures the system audio coming out of the selected device (what is currently playing), not microphone input.

features.name: Real-time Japanese speech recognition
features.description: Transcribes the captured Japanese audio in near real time using faster-whisper on the GPU (CUDA).

features.name: Japanese-to-English translation
features.description: Produces English text from the Japanese audio via Whisper's translate task; structured so additional language pairs can be added later.

features.name: Full-screen subtitle overlay
features.description: A full-screen, fully transparent, click-through, always-on-top window that renders only the subtitle text over whatever application is running.

features.name: Auto-hiding settings bar
features.description: A settings bar pinned to the top of the screen that stays hidden and only appears when the mouse hovers over its region.

features.name: Settings controls
features.description: The settings bar exposes language pair, subtitle appearance (font size, position, background opacity), a latency-vs-accuracy control (Whisper model size), and exit.

features.name: Exit controls
features.description: The app can be stopped from the settings bar or via an exit button in the top-right corner.

features.name: Set-and-forget operation
features.description: After device selection the app runs unattended; no interaction is required during normal use.

features.name: Ephemeral settings
features.description: Settings are not persisted; every launch starts from defaults.

constraints: Solo user, no authentication, occasional use
No settings persistence: fresh defaults every launch
v1 scope-out: a single audio source at a time
Does not use the framework's scaffold templates (zero-dependency Node only); the Python skeleton is built by hand
